title: Parabolas (etc.) — Curves With Different Causes
subtitle: Catenary cables, ballistic water jets, and hand-bent arches vs. fitted hypotheses
lineage: Lineage: Will Hoffman & Derek Paul Boyle, Parabolas (etc.) (2009)
theorem: Use repeated curves to let viewers notice a geometric relation, then make differing causes and imperfect fits part of the film's discovery. A measured resemblance remains open to correction by the object.
boundary_note: All three physical curves are seen cleanly in context before fitted hypothesis guides are overlaid. One guide visibly departs from the hand-bent strip.

v1_defect_timecodes: Seg #03 (t=09.00s-14.00s) & Seg #08 (t=32.20s-36.70s): `efcd23e5` cuts internally from a worker in a hard hat to a vertical beam.
Seg #04 (t=14.00s-19.50s): `09deda36` (`Eyes and Their Care`, 1941) shows a static medical eyeball diagram instead of a ballistic trajectory.
critic_tribunal.largest_gap: Observation 02 (Seg #04) shows a static diagram of an eyeball instead of a moving ballistic arc, and Seg #03/#08 cuts internally across a worker's head.
critic_tribunal.causal_hypothesis: OpenCLIP false positive matching the round eyeball diagram to 'ball in flight', and an unverified cut in `efcd23e5`.
critic_tribunal.falsifiable_repair: Use verified suspension cable shot `b9198dcc` (`0.05s-4.35s`) and overhead catenary wire shot `a4d0d568` (`0.2s-5.2s`) for Observation 01/01B & Replay #08; use `c1613029` (`0.05s-3.45s`, low-flying aircraft arc) and `41941b55` (`2.5s-6.4s`, `custom_window=True`, side-view parabolic water jet) for Observation 02/02B & Replay #09; use `0917faaa` (`0.1s-4.5s`, `custom_window=True`, hands bending flexible tire strip) for Observation 03 & Replay #10.
critic_tribunal.strength_to_preserve: The three-curve comparison card and Replay #09-#10 (`41941b55` water-jet parabola fit and `0917faaa` asymmetric hand-bent strip departing from the symmetric parabola).

edl.title: Fitted Hypothesis Guides
edl.action: Replaying the three curves with mathematical overlays
Hypothesis 1: Catenary curve y = a cosh(x/a) fitted to the hanging Boulder Dam cable
Hypothesis 2: Ballistic parabola y = ax^2 + bx + c fitted to the arcing water jet
Hypothesis 3 (Visible Departure): Symmetric parabola (rust) fails to fit asymmetric hand-bent elastica (mint)
Boulder Dam: Returning to the physical cable with all mathematical overlays removed
